description: This file defines a custom assertion class 'JsonArrayAssert' for testing properties of JSON arrays within the Eclipse Ditto project's JSON handling tests. It provides methods to verify array size, emptiness, array type, containment of values, and exclusion of values, extending base assertion capabilities with project-specific logic.

classes.name: JsonArrayAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for verifying properties of JsonArray objects in unit tests.

methods.name: hasSize
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON array has the expected size.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON array is empty.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON array is not empty.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Verifies that the actual object is recognized as a JSON array.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON array contains the specified value(s), supporting various data types.

methods.name: doesNotContain
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON array does not contain the specified value(s), supporting various data types.
